svg.title: Three unresolved lanes continue beyond the page
svg.desc: Extend all three separate lanes beyond the page edge with no verdict symbol. The unresolved ending preserves the open judgment about each decision.

**Frame:** No resolution and no fourth column. The three lanes continue past the page edge,
still separate. Nothing in the frame says whether any of the three decisions was right.

**Caption:**
> EVERY ONE OF THEM WAS A CHOICE SOMEBODY MADE.
>
> NONE OF THEM CAN TELL YOU IF IT WAS THE RIGHT ONE.

**Provenance:** `inferred` — chapter thesis, stated without absolution.
